title: Bulk DNS & Email Authentication Checker input
description: Paste the domains you want to check, then click Start. URLs and email addresses are turned into domains automatically. Each domain is looked up in public DNS only — the Actor never sends email and needs no API keys.

domains.title: Domains, URLs or emails
domains.description: Required. One domain, website URL or email address per line (for example apify.com, https://apify.com or hello@apify.com). Duplicates are ignored.

dkimSelectors.sectionDescription: Leave these at the defaults for a first run. Add selectors only if a domain uses a custom DKIM selector.
dkimSelectors.title: DKIM selectors to test
dkimSelectors.description: Host prefixes to query as <selector>._domainkey.<domain>. Common selectors are already included (google, selector1, k1, sendgrid, and others). Add your email provider's selector if a known domain shows no DKIM key.

includeRecords.title: Include A/AAAA/CAA records
includeRecords.description: When on, the result also includes IPv4/IPv6 addresses and CAA records for each domain.

concurrency.sectionDescription: Safety caps for large lists. You can leave these unchanged.
concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: How many domains to look up in parallel. Higher is faster; stay within your plan's limits.

maxDomains.title: Max domains per run
maxDomains.description: Safety cap. If the list is longer, only the first N valid domains are checked.
